method: One English-to-Hungarian full-file queued-content job per model, all launched together through the 2.0.0 candidate. Bazarr-compatible payload and authentication; benchmark did not execute inside Bazarr.
cost_note: Observed cost sums usage.cost from returned upstream responses. Missing or interrupted response usage makes this a lower bound. Zero forwarded completion requests establish zero completion charges.
progress_note: completedLines is service-reported translated progress. Returned positions measure structure and may include source fallbacks for partial jobs. Running jobs stopped at the cap may expose progress without result lines.
